Definition: CREATE VIEW [dbo].[AccountYearEndClosing_credit]    AS  SELECT     Account_Sn, Account_No, Account_Name, Credit, Debit, ViewBalance, IsUpdate FROM         dbo.AccountYearEndClosing WHERE     (ViewBalance > 0) AND (IsUpdate = 0)

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_AccountsLastLeve]    AS  SELECT     ID, Account_No, Suspended, Account_Level, Final_Account, Account_Type, Account_Nature, Main_Account_No, Account_Name, E_Account_Name, ParentPath, AccountTypeDesc,                        Account_Nature_Desc, SuspendedDesc, Priv_Debit, Priv_Credit, AddressA,  PhoneA,  FaxA,  Note, UserID_Add, UserID_Update, Account_Name_String, Account_Balance,                        Priv_Balance, ABS(Account_Balance + Priv_Balance) AS ViewBalance, Account_Balance + Priv_Balance AS AccountBalance FROM         dbo.ViewAccount_Data WHERE     (NOT (ID IN                           (SELECT     Main_Account_No                              FROM         dbo.Account_Accounts AS Accounts_1)))

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_AccountYearEndClosing_Debit]    AS  SELECT     Account_Sn, Account_No, Account_Name, Credit, Debit, ViewBalance, IsUpdate FROM         dbo.AccountYearEndClosing WHERE     (ViewBalance < 0) AND (IsUpdate = 0)

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_Budget_Accounts]    AS  SELECT     TOP (100) PERCENT ID, Main_Account_No, dbo.GetTreeNodeLevel(ID) AS NodeLeve, Account_Name, dbo.GetBudgetBalance(ID,1,1) AS BudgetBalance,                        dbo.GetParentPath(ID) AS ParentPath, Account_No, Account_Type FROM         dbo.Account_Accounts WHERE     (ID IN                           (SELECT     Main_Account_No                              FROM         dbo.Account_Accounts AS Accounts_1)) AND (Account_Type IN (1, 2)) ORDER BY Account_Type, Account_No

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_Budget_TempTranMaterDetails] AS SELECT TOP (100) PERCENT Account_Sn, Account_No, Account_Name, SUM(ISNULL(Debit, 0)) AS Debit, SUM(ISNULL(Credit, 0)) AS Credit, SUM(ISNULL(Priv_Credit, 0)) AS Priv_Credit, SUM(ISNULL(Priv_Debit, 0)) AS Priv_Debit, ISNULL(SUM(Debit),                    0) - ISNULL(SUM(Credit), 0) + ISNULL(SUM(Priv_Debit), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(Priv_Credit), 0) AS NowBalance, ISNULL(SUM(Priv_Debit), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(Priv_Credit), 0) AS PrivBalance, dbo.GetParentPath(Account_Sn) AS HierarchicalPath,                    BranchID, UserID FROM     dbo.TempBudget WHERE  (Account_Sn IN                       (SELECT ID                        FROM      dbo.Account_Accounts                        WHERE   (Account_Type IN (1, 2)))) GROUP BY Account_Sn, Account_No, Account_Name, dbo.GetParentPath(Account_Sn), BranchID, UserID ORDER BY Account_No

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_Distinct_AccountSn_TempTran] AS SELECT DISTINCT Account_Sn, Account_No, dbo.GetTreeNodeLevel(Account_Sn) AS Account_Level, Account_Name, BranchID, UserID FROM     dbo.TempTranMaterDetails

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_New_CostCenter] AS SELECT dbo.ViewTranCostCenters.CostCentersID,        dbo.ViewTranCostCenters.Credit,        dbo.ViewTranCostCenters.Debit,        dbo.Account_CostCenters.CostCentersName,        dbo.Account_CostCenters.Priv_Credit,        dbo.Account_CostCenters.Priv_Debit,        dbo.Account_CostCenters.Priv_Credit + dbo.ViewTranCostCenters.Credit AS NewCredit,        dbo.Account_CostCenters.Priv_Debit + dbo.ViewTranCostCenters.Debit AS NewDebit FROM dbo.ViewTranCostCenters     INNER JOIN dbo.Account_CostCenters         ON dbo.ViewTranCostCenters.CostCentersID = dbo.Account_CostCenters.CostCentersID;
CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_Temp_Acc_Budget]    AS  SELECT     Account_Sn, Account_No, Account_Name, Credit, Debit, ISNULL(Credit, 0) - ISNULL(Debit, 0) AS ViewBalance FROM         dbo.TempBudget

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_TempTranMaterDetails]    AS  SELECT     TOP (100) PERCENT Account_Sn, Account_No, Account_Name, ISNULL(SUM(Debit), 0) AS Debit, ISNULL(SUM(Credit), 0) AS Credit, ISNULL(SUM(Priv_Credit), 0) AS Priv_Credit,                        ISNULL(SUM(Priv_Debit), 0) AS Priv_Debit, ISNULL(SUM(Debit), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(Credit), 0) + ISNULL(SUM(Priv_Debit), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(Priv_Credit), 0) AS NowBalance,                        ISNULL(SUM(Priv_Debit), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(Priv_Credit), 0) AS PrivBalance FROM         dbo.TempTranMaterDetails WHERE     (Account_Sn IN                           (SELECT     Temp_Account_Sn                              FROM         dbo.Temp_Accounts)) GROUP BY Account_Sn, Account_No, Account_Name ORDER BY Account_No

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_TranDetails]    AS  SELECT     dbo.Tran_Tran.ID, dbo.Tran_Tran.TranDate, dbo.Tran_TranDetails.Account_Sn, dbo.Tran_TranDetails.Credit, dbo.Tran_TranDetails.Debit, dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_No, dbo.Tran_TranDetails.BranchID FROM         dbo.Tran_Tran INNER JOIN                       dbo.Tran_TranDetails ON dbo.Tran_Tran.ID = dbo.Tran_TranDetails.TranSn AND Tran_TranDetails.BranchID = Tran_Tran.BranchID INNER JOIN                       dbo.Account_Accounts ON dbo.Tran_TranDetails.Account_Sn = dbo.Account_Accounts.ID

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_TrialBalance]    AS  SELECT     TOP (100) PERCENT Account_Sn, Account_No, Account_Name, SUM(ISNULL(Debit, 0)) AS Debit, SUM(ISNULL(Credit, 0)) AS Credit, SUM(ISNULL(Priv_Credit, 0))                        AS Priv_Credit, SUM(ISNULL(Priv_Debit, 0)) AS Priv_Debit, SUM(ISNULL(Priv_Debit, 0) - ISNULL(Priv_Credit, 0)) AS PrivBalance FROM         dbo.TempTranMaterDetails GROUP BY Account_Sn, Account_No, Account_Name ORDER BY CONVERT(VARCHAR(30), Account_No)

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[View_TrialBalanceByTotal]    AS  SELECT     Account_Sn, Account_No, Account_Name, dbo.SetPriv_CreditBalance(Account_Sn, BranchID, UserID) AS Priv_Credit, dbo.SetPriv_DebitBalance(Account_Sn, BranchID, UserID) AS Priv_Debit, BranchID, UserID,                       dbo.SetCreditBalance(Account_Sn, BranchID, UserID) AS Credit, dbo.SetDebitBalance(Account_Sn, BranchID, UserID) AS Debit, Account_Level FROM         dbo.View_Distinct_AccountSn_TempTran

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[ViewAccount_Data] AS SELECT  dbo.Account_Accounts.ID ,             dbo.CleanField(dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_No) AS Account_No ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.Suspended ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Level ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.Final_Account ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Type ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Nature ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.Main_Account_No ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Name ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.E_Account_Name ,             dbo.GetParentPath(dbo.Account_Accounts.ID) AS ParentPath ,             dbo.Account_Type.Name AS  AccountTypeDesc,             dbo.Account_Nature.Name AS Account_Nature_Desc ,             dbo.Account_Suspended.Name AS SuspendedDesc,             dbo.Account_Accounts.Priv_Debit ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.Priv_Credit ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.AddressA ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.PhoneA ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.FaxA ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.Note ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.UserID_Add ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.UserID_Update ,             CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_No) + N'- '             + dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Name AS Account_Name_String ,             ( SELECT    ISNULL(SUM(Debit), 0) - ISNULL(SUM(Credit), 0) AS Expr1               FROM      dbo.Tran_TranDetails               WHERE     ( Account_Sn = dbo.Account_Accounts.ID )             ) AS Account_Balance ,             ISNULL(dbo.Account_Accounts.Priv_Debit, 0)             - ISNULL(dbo.Account_Accounts.Priv_Credit, 0) AS Priv_Balance ,             dbo.Account_Final.Name AS Final_Account_Desc, dbo.Account_Accounts.BranchID     FROM    dbo.Account_Nature             INNER JOIN dbo.Account_Accounts ON dbo.Account_Nature.ID = dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Nature             INNER JOIN dbo.Account_Type ON dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Type = dbo.Account_Type.ID             INNER JOIN dbo.Account_Suspended ON dbo.Account_Accounts.Suspended = dbo.Account_Suspended.ID             INNER JOIN dbo.Account_Final ON dbo.Account_Accounts.Final_Account = dbo.Account_Final.ID;

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[ViewAccount_Data_Tree] AS   SELECT  dbo.Account_Accounts.ID ,             dbo.Account_Accounts.Main_Account_No ,             CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_No) + N'- '             + dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Name AS N'اسم الحساب' ,             dbo.GetParentPath(dbo.Account_Accounts.ID) AS N'مسار الحساب' ,             dbo.Account_Final.Name AS N'الحساب الختامي' ,             dbo.Account_Type.Name AS N'نوع الحساب' ,             dbo.Account_Nature.Name AS N'طبيعة الحساب'     FROM    dbo.Account_Nature             INNER JOIN dbo.Account_Accounts ON dbo.Account_Nature.ID = dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Nature             INNER JOIN dbo.Account_Type ON dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Type = dbo.Account_Type.ID             INNER JOIN dbo.Account_Suspended ON dbo.Account_Accounts.Suspended = dbo.Account_Suspended.ID             INNER JOIN dbo.Account_Final ON dbo.Account_Accounts.Final_Account = dbo.Account_Final.ID;

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[ViewAccountsLastLeve]    AS  SELECT     ID, Account_No, Suspended, Account_Level, Final_Account, Account_Type, Account_Nature, Main_Account_No, Account_Name, E_Account_Name, ParentPath, AccountTypeDesc,                        Account_Nature_Desc, SuspendedDesc, Priv_Debit, Priv_Credit, AddressA,  PhoneA,  FaxA,  Note, UserID_Add, UserID_Update, Account_Name_String, Account_Balance,                        Priv_Balance, ABS(Account_Balance + Priv_Balance) AS ViewBalance, Account_Balance + Priv_Balance AS AccountBalance, Final_Account_Desc,ISNULL(BranchID,0) AS BranchID FROM         dbo.ViewAccount_Data WHERE     (NOT (ID IN                           (SELECT     Main_Account_No                              FROM         dbo.Account_Accounts AS Accounts_1)))

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[ViewCostCenters_Data_Tree] AS SELECT       SN,     CostCentersID,     MainCostCentersID,     CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), CostCentersNo) + N'- ' + CostCentersName AS  N'اسم الحساب' FROM dbo.Account_CostCenters

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[ViewTran_TranDetails]    AS  SELECT     TOP (100) PERCENT dbo.Tran_TranDetails.Sn, dbo.Tran_TranDetails.TranSn, dbo.Tran_TranDetails.Account_Sn, dbo.Tran_TranDetails.TranDesc, dbo.Tran_TranDetails.Debit, dbo.Tran_TranDetails.Credit,                        dbo.CleanField(dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_No) AS Account_No, dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Name, dbo.Tran_TranDetails.AccounIindex, dbo.Tran_TranDetails.CostCentersID, dbo.Account_CostCenters.CostCentersNo,                        dbo.Account_CostCenters.CostCentersName, dbo.Tran_Tran.LedgerID, dbo.Tran_Type.ID, dbo.Tran_Type.Name,dbo.Tran_TranDetails.BranchID FROM         dbo.Account_Accounts INNER JOIN                       dbo.Tran_TranDetails ON dbo.Account_Accounts.ID = dbo.Tran_TranDetails.Account_Sn INNER JOIN                        dbo.Tran_Tran ON dbo.Tran_TranDetails.TranSn = dbo.Tran_Tran.ID AND [Tran_Tran].[BranchID] = dbo.Tran_TranDetails.[BranchID] INNER JOIN                       dbo.Tran_Type ON dbo.Tran_Tran.TranTypeID = dbo.Tran_Type.ID LEFT JOIN dbo.Account_CostCenters ON dbo.Tran_TranDetails.CostCentersID = dbo.Account_CostCenters.CostCentersID AND Account_CostCenters.BranchID = dbo.Tran_TranDetails.BranchID ORDER BY dbo.Tran_TranDetails.AccounIindex

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[ViewTranCostCenters]    AS  SELECT     SUM(Debit) AS Debit, SUM(Credit) AS Credit, CostCentersID FROM         dbo.Tran_TranDetails GROUP BY CostCentersID HAVING      (CostCentersID > 0)

CREATE VIEW [dbo].[ViewTranMaterDetails]    AS  SELECT     dbo.Tran_Tran.ID, dbo.Tran_Tran.TranTypeID, dbo.Tran_Tran.TranCode, dbo.Tran_Tran.TranDate, dbo.Tran_Type.Name, dbo.Tran_Tran.Note, TranDetails_1.Account_Sn, TranDetails_1.TranDesc,                        TranDetails_1.Debit, TranDetails_1.Credit, dbo.Subtraction(TranDetails_1.Debit, TranDetails_1.Credit) AS SumValues, dbo.CleanField(dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_No) AS Account_No,                        dbo.Account_Accounts.Account_Name, TranDetails_1.AccounIindex, dbo.Tran_Tran.ReceivedFrom, dbo.Tran_Tran.ReferenceCode,[dbo].[GetTranBalnce](TranDetails_1.TranSn,dbo.[Tran_Tran].BranchID) AS TransBalance, dbo.Account_Accounts.Priv_Debit, dbo.Account_Accounts.Priv_Credit,                           /*(SELECT     ISNULL(SUM(Debit), 0) AS TransBalance                              FROM         dbo.Tran_TranDetails                              WHERE     (TranSn = TranSn)) AS TransBalance,*/ TranDetails_1.Sn, TranDetails_1.CostCentersID, dbo.Tran_Tran.DocCode, dbo.Tran_Tran.LedgerID,dbo.Tran_Tran.BranchID, 					(SELECT dbo.Account_CostCenters.CostCentersNo FROM dbo.Account_CostCenters WHERE TranDetails_1.CostCentersID = dbo.Account_CostCenters.CostCentersID AND Account_CostCenters.BranchID = TranDetails_1.BranchID)  					  AS CostCentersNo, 					(SELECT dbo.Account_CostCenters.CostCentersName FROM dbo.Account_CostCenters WHERE TranDetails_1.CostCentersID = dbo.Account_CostCenters.CostCentersID AND Account_CostCenters.BranchID = TranDetails_1.BranchID) 					  AS CostCentersName, 					(SELECT dbo.Account_CostCenters.MainCostCentersID FROM dbo.Account_CostCenters WHERE TranDetails_1.CostCentersID = dbo.Account_CostCenters.CostCentersID AND Account_CostCenters.BranchID = TranDetails_1.BranchID)  					  AS MainCostCentersID FROM         dbo.Tran_Tran INNER JOIN                       dbo.Tran_Type ON dbo.Tran_Tran.TranTypeID = dbo.Tran_Type.ID INNER JOIN                       dbo.Tran_TranDetails AS TranDetails_1 ON dbo.Tran_Tran.ID = TranDetails_1.TranSn AND TranDetails_1.BranchID = [dbo].[Tran_Tran].BranchID  INNER JOIN                       dbo.Account_Accounts ON TranDetails_1.Account_Sn = dbo.Account_Accounts.ID  					  --INNER JOIN        --               dbo.Account_CostCenters ON TranDetails_1.CostCentersID = dbo.Account_CostCenters.CostCentersID
